canonical_name: No Supply Chain Risk Management Policy
description: Supply chain risk management policy and procedures are not developed, documented, and maintained to address purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination, and compliance.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Federal information systems processing sensitive data

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing supply chain risk management policy documentation, outdated or non-existent procedures, lack of policy dissemination evidence, absence of defined roles and responsibilities for supply chain risk management, and lack of integration with enterprise risk management programs. Check for missing references to applicable laws, regulations, and standards governing supply chain security.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Supply Chain Risk Management
FISMA - Federal Information Security Modernization Act
